quotes.text: We had a wonderful cruise on the intercoastal waterway with Captain Rob! He had a very nice and clean boat, covered safety items such as where life jackets are, etc. He is knowledgeable about the waterways, the wildlife and the history of this beautiful area and most importantly he is qualified as a boat captain. We felt safe and in good hands at all times. The cruise from Isle of Hope was breathtakingly beautiful! My friend who went with me and who had never been to Savanna.

We had a fantastic time with Captain Rob! His knowledge of the area and wildlife was superior! The cruise was relaxed and very enjoyable! A great conversationist, Captain Rob made it easy to enjoy the evening. We were able to see a ton of wildlife including many types of birds and even a few dolphin. A great way to spend the evening with a loved one or just friends!!

We had an absolutely amazing boat ride on Moon River! We saw eagle nests, roseate spoonbills, herons, an anhinga, and of course dolphins! Captain Rob is a great captain and host. He knows the area extremely well and has so many interesting stories to share. We really enjoyed our time out there, especially when we sang Moon River together 🙂

Captain Rob Faddis was remarkable! He knew the history of the marshes, rivers, dolphins, and timed it perfectly for a sunset and a full moon. This is truly an experience everyone should have to more fully understand the beauty and impact of the marshes and waterways of Savannah! We cannot wait to do another cruise with Captain Rob!!

Great experience with Captain Rob. Easy communication. Set for a time as a small storm was coming in . Rob texted In advance with the option. We decided to wait and let the storm blow over. What a great decision,,! Beautiful sunset on way back to marina. All we could talk about today was Captain Rob's hospitality.

Such a delightful and memorable morning excursion. Exploring the islands from the waterway gave us a captivating perspective. Captain Rob was an absolute pleasure. He was attentive and informative. We are are already planning our next charter with Isle of Hope Cruises. I highly recommend them.
